summary: WP-006 code review passed. SortManager::getSortURL() now carries a @return docblock with the exact XSS safety note required by the WP spec. comments.note: The @return docblock text matches the WP spec exactly: 'The sort URL. When used outside HTMLTag contexts, callers must apply htmlspecialchars() to prevent XSS.' Communicates the security requirement clearly.

No blocking issues. Both changes are precise documentation fixes with no behavioral impact.
